integrity_notes: Analytical proof supplied. A standard-library verifier was executed from the packaged source and its actual output is included. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed interior Bernoulli attachment parameter and two-predecessor finite recursive trees only.
The Gaussian limit concerns tree-to-tree fluctuations of conditional walk hitting-time means, not walk-path hitting times.
The general deterministic hitting-time formula and inverse-renewal functional central limit theorem are established inputs, not new claims.
The historical-priority comparison with Oosthuizen--Wagner (2017) was limited to its abstract; independent historical assessment remains appropriate.
title: Joint Gaussian fluctuations of opposite hitting-time means in Bernoulli recursive trees
